title: Alloyed Partners with Beam AI to Put AI Agents Into Client Operations
excerpt: Alloyed partners with Beam AI to deploy and manage AI agents in client operations, combining process discovery, automation, and human oversight.
bodyMarkdown:
*Partnership brings AI agent deployment, orchestration, and governance into Alloyed's managed-services delivery model: mapping how client work happens, selecting the automation worth doing, and deploying the selected agents under Alloyed's operators' oversight.*

**Marlton, New Jersey – September 15, 2026** – Alloyed today announced a strategic partnership with Beam AI, an enterprise agentic AI platform. Alloyed will map how a client's processes actually run, rank what is worth automating, build agents for those steps on Beam's platform, and keep its own operators on the exceptions, bringing AI agents into live client operations inside the managed-services model clients already buy.

As organizations move beyond AI experimentation, the constraint is rarely the models. It is that individual AI tools solve isolated tasks, while the outcome depends on a chain of decisions, handoffs, and exceptions. What enterprises need is a way to manage an entire workforce of intelligent agents working alongside their people. Together, Alloyed and Beam AI will help them build that workforce, automate complex operations, and improve business performance.

Building that workforce runs in four stages: map how a process actually runs, using Beam's Process Discovery; rank what is worth automating; build the selected agents; and run them under human oversight, with everything operators catch feeding into its self-learning algorithm, measured against the same service levels. Each stage produces the input to the next, so nothing is rebuilt between analysis and delivery, the gap where most pilots stall.

Unlike a platform handed to a client to operate, or a study that ends in a report, the value here is in the combination. Agents run the standard path at speed and volume; Alloyed's operators own exceptions and edge cases, with defined escalation, so work an agent does not recognize stops with a person rather than passing through. In an invoice-approval process, for example, agents clear the invoices that match, and an operator sees every one that does not. Because Alloyed's operators understand the client's business, known exceptions are documented before build and accuracy standards are set per engagement, in the client's own service levels.

Individual agents matter less than the networks they form. As more of the operation is mapped, they work across every process a result depends on, handing tasks to each other and bringing in people where judgment is needed, and each new area starts with more context than the last.

"The future of enterprise operations isn't about replacing people with AI, it's about orchestrating teams of people and intelligent agents working together," said **Lauren Kochan, CEO of Alloyed**. "Beam AI gives us the ability to put agents into a client's operation alongside their teams, under governance the client can see, while Alloyed provides the operational expertise to put those agents into live processes. Together, we're helping organizations move beyond isolated AI initiatives to truly AI-native operations."

The partnership enables organizations to:

- **Know what is worth automating before committing:** Compare opportunities on value, readiness, payback, and delivery risk
- **Move from decision to production:** Carry process flows, controls, and test cases straight into the build
- **Hold accuracy where errors are expensive:** Standards set in the client's own service levels, with a person on every case outside an agent's scope
- **Connect agents across processes end to end:** Automate every step a result depends on, and reuse what is learned about the process inside the client's own operation

"The hard part of enterprise AI is not building agents, it is knowing which work is worth automating," said **Jonas Diezun, CEO of Beam AI**. "Process Discovery gives Alloyed and its clients that answer on evidence: where the work breaks, what those exceptions cost, and which fixes are worth funding. We then build agents for precisely those steps. Accuracy is won or lost on the exceptions, and that is where Alloyed's operators are irreplaceable."

Beam AI provides the platform to discover, build, deploy, orchestrate, and govern AI agents across the enterprise. Alloyed brings the operational expertise to integrate those agents into live business processes.

Alloyed clients can start by asking their account lead to scope a first process; discovery on one process takes weeks, not months.

This partnership is another step in Alloyed's strategy to build an ecosystem of leading AI technologies. By combining the right people, processes, and platforms, Alloyed helps clients modernize operations and create intelligent, high-performing businesses.

### About Alloyed

Alloyed helps organizations move faster and perform better by orchestrating a fusion of process excellence, human expertise, and fit-for-purpose automation tailored to their workflows, technology stack, and scale. Through its cognitive process orchestration approach, Alloyed combines decades of operational experience with modern technology to deliver predictable performance and measurable business outcomes.

### About Beam AI

Beam AI is an enterprise agentic AI platform that enables organizations to discover, create, deploy, orchestrate, and govern AI agents across complex business operations. Its Process Discovery maps how work actually runs and ranks automation opportunities on evidence; its platform turns the selected opportunities into secure, scalable AI workforces that integrate with existing systems and accelerate operational transformation.

title: Alloyed Announces Strategic Partnership with SimpliSmart LLC to Deliver Accelerated, End-to-End AI-Powered Enterprise Operations
excerpt: Alloyed announces strategic partnership with SimpliSmart LLC to deliver accelerated, end-to-end AI-powered enterprise operations.
bodyMarkdown:
**Marlton, New Jersey – July 29, 2026** – **Alloyed,** a global managed business solutions provider, announced a strategic partnership with [**SimpliSmart LLC**](http://simplismart.io/), expanding its ecosystem of technology partners dedicated to helping organizations modernize operations through intelligent automation and AI-enabled solutions. Together, the companies will help organizations implement AI while maintaining the human expertise needed to achieve measurable results.

"As organizations navigate the next generation of business operations, they need partners who can help them move from AI experimentation to AI execution," said **Lauren Kochan, Chief Executive Officer of Alloyed**. "Our partnership with SimpliSmart LLC strengthens our ability to deliver practical, scalable AI solutions that improve performance, reduce operational complexity, and help our clients achieve meaningful business outcomes."

Through the partnership, Alloyed and SimpliSmart LLC will help organizations:

- Transform complex processes by embedding AI-automated workflows that orchestrate people, systems, and enterprise applications
- Improve operational efficiency and service delivery
- Reduce manual effort across high-volume workflows
- Enhance employee productivity and customer experiences
- Accelerate enterprise AI adoption through practical, scalable solutions
- Deliver measurable business outcomes through integrated operational and AI transformation strategies

"Organizations won't realize the true value of AI by deploying standalone AI tools. They'll realize it when AI becomes an intelligent, decision-making component embedded within end-to-end automated business processes," said **Matt Gustitus, Chief Executive Officer of SimpliSmart LLC**. "Our partnership with Alloyed will enable clients to automate complete business processes where AI augments human decisions, orchestrates work across systems, and delivers impactful business outcomes at enterprise scale."

Alloyed and SimpliSmart LLC will launch a series of joint go-to-market initiatives designed to help business leaders move beyond AI experimentation to operational execution. The collaboration will begin with a live executive webinar exploring how organizations can embed AI into enterprise workflows by combining cognitive process orchestration with intelligent automation.

The first joint webinar, *From Automation to Agentic AI: Building the Next Generation of Managed Services,* will be held on Thursday, August 20, 2026, at 2:00 PM EST. Registration is available at: [https://www.mediafinance.org/town-hall-webinars](https://www.mediafinance.org/town-hall-webinars).

The partnership combines Alloyed's process expertise with SimpliSmart LLC's AI and automation technology, reflecting their commitment to building an ecosystem of best-in-class technology partners that complement its cognitive process orchestration approach. By combining deep operational expertise with leading AI technologies, Alloyed empowers organizations to deploy the right mix of people, processes, and automation to achieve predictable performance and sustainable growth.

title: Alloyed and Supervity Partner to Deliver People + AI Solutions for Enterprise Operations
excerpt: Alloyed and Supervity announce a strategic partnership delivering People + AI solutions that automate enterprise operations, improve efficiency, and accelerate transformation.
bodyMarkdown:
**Marlton, New Jersey – July 1, 2026** – [**Alloyed**](https://alloyed.io/), a global managed business solutions provider, and [**Supervity**](https://www.supervity.ai/), a leading agentic AI platform, today announced a strategic partnership that pairs their capabilities and technology to run high-volume enterprise workflows across functions including finance, procurement, HR, IT, and customer operations.

As enterprises work to scale AI, there can be a stall on talent, cost, execution, and change management. This partnership offers an alternative path that delivers measurable value from day one to these enterprises. Alloyed focuses on operational responsibility from the outset, so organizations see results without diverting internal resources to lengthy implementations.

"Companies don't need more to manage; they need outcomes," said **Lauren Kochan, CEO of Alloyed**. "Our partnership with Supervity combines the power of AI with the operational expertise required to make transformation successful. Together, we're helping clients move faster, perform better, and realize the benefits of automation without disrupting their business."

Alloyed and Supervity will build a foundation for lasting automation and transformation, helping organizations:

- Accelerate automation initiatives with reduced implementation burden
- Improve operational efficiency and business performance
- Streamline high-volume, repetitive workflows across core operations
- Enhance employee and customer experiences
- Scale AI adoption with greater confidence, governance and oversight
- Generate measurable business outcomes through a balanced People + AI approach

Unlike traditional automation deployments that require organizations to divert internal resources to lengthy implementations, Alloyed assumes operational responsibility from the outset. Alloyed's specialists manage and optimize workflows, while Supervity's AI Employees automate routine tasks, providing immediate relief and a clear path to greater automation over time.

"At Supervity, we believe AI should work alongside people to make organizations more productive, effective, and agile," said **Siva Moduga, Co-Founder & CEO of Supervity**. "By partnering with Alloyed, we're combining advanced AI capabilities with deep operational expertise to help enterprises achieve real business impact faster."

The collaboration reflects Alloyed's vision for the future of business operations: orchestrating the right combination of people, processes, and technology to deliver predictable, measurable results.

### About Alloyed

title: Alloyed Solutions Inc. Announces Management Buyout and New CEO
excerpt: Led by a core group of the company's internal leaders, the transaction represents a powerful vote of confidence in newly named Alloyed Solutions and the direction ahead.
bodyMarkdown:
**Marlton, NJ – June 9, 2026** – [Alloyed](https://alloyed.io/), a global managed business solutions provider, announced the completion of a management buyout (MBO) of its U.S. operations. Led by a core group of the company's internal leaders, the transaction represents a powerful vote of confidence in newly named Alloyed Solutions and the direction ahead.

Effective immediately, Lauren Kochan has been named Chief Executive Officer. A longtime leader, Lauren has been instrumental in driving the company's strategic vision and is deeply embedded in company operations. Her leadership has been central in the company's extraordinary growth over the past decade, helping it scale while ensuring exceptional client service.

Kevin Kochan, who led the company for 19 years as CEO, has transitioned to a new opportunity. His contributions built the strong platform of today.

"We're proud of the foundation two decades of work has built, and we're excited to push it further," said Lauren Kochan, CEO. "Our clients are part of our journey and without them we wouldn't be here. We continue to have the same teams and expertise, while enhancing our ability to deliver what matters most, our clients' results."

Alloyed's day-to-day operations, active projects, deliverables, support channels, account management, and contractual commitments remain fully intact. The same teams, systems, and service standards that clients have come to rely on will continue without interruption.

Alloyed's new home is at [alloyed.io](https://alloyed.io/).

### About Alloyed

Alloyed is a global operations partner that fuses human expertise, AI-enabled automation, and proven process design to help businesses run faster, scale smarter, be more flexible, and perform at a higher level. Built on two decades of delivery experience, Alloyed's global delivery teams and onshore client leadership are embedded into clients' operations bringing governance, real-time reporting, and measured outcomes from day one. Learn more at [alloyed.io](https://alloyed.io/).
